newsitem.title: USA: Commission oks Central Louisiana rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Commission oks Central Louisiana rate cut.

text.p: Central Louisiana Electric Co Inc said the Louisiana Public Service Commission has approved a plan providing for the company to lower its electric rates effective November 1.
Central Louisiana said the first decrease will take effect on November 1, with a second decrease scheduled for January 1, 1998.

It said that rates will be lowered by $3 million per year with the November reduction, and will again be lowered by $2 million in January, 1998. In addition, the company said its rate reduction plan calls for rates to be capped for a period of five years beginning in November.
